description: registry.json marks earn/audit status 'live' (registry.json:132) with a summary asserting it 'discover[s] live code4rena/Cantina contests + analyze one in-scope contract + draft candidate finding daily'. In reality: Cantina is not implemented at all (only code4rena is scraped, run.sh:23), 'live' contests are actually closed (FIND-001), analyze/draft is a no-op stub (FIND-004), and no daily fire is guaranteed (FIND-005). Marking it 'live' (same status string as the genuinely-running clip/video slots) overstates maturity and will mislead the cross-loop AUDITOR (master:26-30) whose job is to judge 'will this actually work' — it will read 'live' and a healthy tmux session and conclude the slot is functioning while it is structurally incapable of earning.
